{'text': "Earlier this year, Bloomberg's Mark Gurman revealed that Apple is working on an entry-level MacBook Pro with an M7 chip, expected to launch in spring 2027. However, this is not a typical MacBook Pro refresh, as it will bring the upcoming new design down to the entry-level lineup, which was previously unthinkable.", 'paragraph_context': '今年較早時，Bloomberg 的 Mark Gurman 透露，Apple 正在開發一款搭載 M7 晶片的入門級 MacBook Pro，預計於 2027 年春季推出。然而，這並非一次普通的 MacBook Pro 更新，因為它將把即將推出的新設計下放到入門級產品線，這在過去是意想不到的。'}

{'text': 'Generally, when Apple introduces a new MacBook Pro design, it takes time before that design trickles down to the lower-tier models. For instance, the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M1 Pro and M1 Max launched in 2021, but the base-model MacBook Pro stuck with the 13-inch design until 2023, when it finally adopted the 14-inch body with an M3 chip.', 'paragraph_context': '一般而言，當 Apple 推出新的 MacBook Pro 設計時，該設計需要一段時間才會下放到較低階的型號。例如，配備 M1 Pro 和 M1 Max 的 14 吋 MacBook Pro 於 2021 年推出，但基本型號的 MacBook Pro 一直沿用 13 吋設計，直到 2023 年才換上配備 M3 晶片的 14 吋機身。'}

{'text': "Similarly, after Apple redesigned the MacBook Pro in 2016, the Touch Bar didn't make it to the base model until 2019. The 2012 Retina MacBook Pro redesign followed a similar pattern.", 'paragraph_context': '同樣地，Apple 在 2016 年重新設計 MacBook Pro 後，Touch Bar 直到 2019 年才出現在基本型號上。2012 年的 Retina MacBook Pro 重新設計也有類似情況。'}

{'text': 'This time around, though, the gap between the new design reaching the entry-level model is only around 6 months.', 'paragraph_context': '不過今次，新設計下放到入門級型號的時間差距只有大約 6 個月。'}

{'text': 'Entry-Level with M7 Gets the New Design', 'paragraph_context': '搭載 M7 嘅入門級配備新設計'}

{'text': 'According to Bloomberg, Apple will bring the new design to the entry-level MacBook Pro in early 2027, shortly after the rumored high-end MacBook Pro, dubbed the MacBook Ultra, makes its debut. The report states:', 'paragraph_context': '據 Bloomberg 報道，Apple 將於 2027 年初將新設計引進入門級 MacBook Pro，緊接在傳聞中名為 MacBook Ultra 的高階 MacBook Pro 首次亮相之後。報道內容如下：'}

{'text': 'Notably, the entry-level MacBook Pro with the current design and an M6 chip will also arrive this fall, alongside the redesigned high-end MacBook Pro.', 'paragraph_context': '值得留意的是，配備現行設計及 M6 晶片的入門級 MacBook Pro 亦將於今年秋季登場，與重新設計的高階 MacBook Pro 一同發布。'}

{'text': 'Even more confusingly, those redesigned high-end MacBook Pros are also expected to feature M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, rather than M6-generation chips. Apple recently scrapped its plans for high-end M6 chips and is instead accelerating M7 development.', 'paragraph_context': '更令人費解的是，這些重新設計的高階 MacBook Pro 亦預計將配備 M5 Pro 和 M5 Max 晶片，而非 M6 世代晶片。Apple 近日決定放棄高階 M6 晶片的計劃，轉而加快 M7 的開發進度。'}

{'text': "In short, here's what the lineup will look like:", 'paragraph_context': '簡單來說，產品線將會係咁樣：'}

  • {'text': 'Fall 2026: Entry-level MacBook Pro with M6 chip and old design; high-end models with M5 Pro/Max chips and new design', 'paragraph_context': '2026 年秋季：入門級 MacBook Pro 配備 M6 晶片及舊設計，高階型號配備 M5 Pro/Max 晶片及新設計'}
  • {'text': 'Spring 2027: Entry-level MacBook Pro with M7 chip and new design', 'paragraph_context': '2027 年春季：入門級 MacBook Pro 配備 M7 晶片及新設計'}
  • {'text': 'Fall 2027: High-end MacBook Pro with M7 Pro and M7 Max chips', 'paragraph_context': '2027 年秋季：高階 MacBook Pro 配備 M7 Pro 及 M7 Max 晶片'}

{'text': 'Of course, the new design is expected to feature a thinner chassis, a touch-enabled OLED display, and possibly even a Dynamic Island.', 'paragraph_context': '當然，新設計預計會採用更纖薄的機身、支援觸控的 OLED 顯示屏，甚至可能配備 Dynamic Island。'}

{'text': 'Wrap-Up', 'paragraph_context': '總結'}

{'text': "Given the recent price hikes, this is good news for some consumers. The new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M5 Pro will likely cost well over $2,500, so if you want the new design with an M7 chip on a tighter budget, you'll only have to wait until the following spring.", 'paragraph_context': '鑑於最近的加價，對部分消費者而言這是個好消息。配備 M5 Pro 的新版 14 吋 MacBook Pro 售價很可能超過 2,500 美元，因此如果想以較低預算入手配備 M7 晶片及新設計的機款，只需等待翌年春季便可。'}

{'text': 'Top comment by Oliver Privé', 'paragraph_context': 'Top comment by Oliver Privé'}

{'text': "I wish Apple would go back to its old lineup update strategy, where it refreshed all its laptops at once, all its iPads at once, etc. But for the past few years, it's only been issuing scattered updates, sometimes with no logic to the lineup at all (e.g., M4 Pro coexisting with base-model M5). If I ever need to upgrade my computer, I'm stuck choosing between waiting for a new model that never seems to come and buying something already outdated. It just doesn't make sense. The only lineup that remains consistent is the iPhone, which sees all models updated at the same time every year, though occasionally there's a minor update to the base model… Their release cadence is also getting slower and slower, and by the time a new iPad launches, rumors and specs for the next one are already swirling… It just doesn't make business sense.", 'paragraph_context': '我希望 Apple 能夠回復到以往的產品線更新策略，同時為所有筆電統一改款，同時為所有 iPad 統一改款，等等。但過去幾年，他們只係零碎地推出更新，有時產品線更係毫無邏輯（例如 M4 Pro 同基本版 M5 並存）。如果我終於要升級電腦，就會陷入要等一部永遠等唔到嘅新機定要買已經過時嘅型號嘅兩難局面。呢個做法實在講唔通。唯一保持穩定嘅係 iPhone 嘅產品線，每年都會同時更新所有型號，雖然間中都會出現基本型號嘅零星更新……佢哋嘅推出節奏亦變得越來越慢，到一部新 iPad 推出時，下一代嘅傳聞同規格已經滿天飛……商業角度上實在講唔通。'}

{'text': "The current $1,999 price tag for the entry-level MacBook Pro is almost the same as the Pro-chip version cost just a year ago, which is admittedly unfortunate, but it's an unavoidable reality in this chip-constrained environment.", 'paragraph_context': '現時入門級 MacBook Pro 嘅 1,999 美元定價，幾乎等於一年前配備 Pro 晶片版本嘅售價，呢個情況的確令人遺憾，但係呢個晶片短缺嘅環境下無可避免嘅現實。'}

{'text': 'Are you looking forward to the new MacBook Pro with an M7 chip? Let us know in the comments.', 'paragraph_context': '你期待搭載 M7 晶片嘅新版 MacBook Pro 嗎？歡迎喺留言區分享你嘅睇法。'}
